title: What Are the Best AI Penetration Testing Tools in South Korea? [October 2026]
summary: Compare the best AI penetration testing tools in South Korea for 2026: MindFort, XBOW, Pentera, Horizon3.ai, RunSybil, PentAGI, SK Shieldus, and Theori.
body_markdown:
This guide explains why Korean companies are under pressure to run more penetration tests in 2026. It compares six AI pentesting tools with two leading Korean security firms. It also covers what ISMS-P requires.


## Why do South Korean companies need penetration testing now?


Attackers hit at least seven Korean financial institutions in late September and October 2026,[The Record reported ↗](https://therecord.media/south-korean-bank-hacks-ai-agents) . At least 68,000 customers were affected, including about 25,000 at Shinhan. CrowdStrike found the attacker used[ARTEX, an agentic pentesting tool developed in China ↗](https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/hacker-used-artex-ai-and-claude-agents-to-target-south-korean-banks/) , with models including DeepSeek and Claude Code.


## What does ISMS-P require for penetration testing?


In April 2026, MSIT and the PIPC[announced that audits will add vulnerability diagnosis and penetration testing ↗](https://www.shinkim.com/eng/media/newsletter/3254) . ISMS-P also becomes mandatory for telecoms and other large data handlers, with full rollout in 2027.

### 1. What is MindFort best for?


MindFort deploys autonomous AI agents that run black-box and white-box tests on your apps continuously. It's the fastest tool on this list to get started: run a test today and get findings in hours without a sales call. Every finding ships with proof of exploit, a pull request with a validated fix, and a retest. MindFort is a newer company with less funding than XBOW or Pentera.


### 2. What is XBOW best for?


XBOW runs autonomous pentests against[web applications and their APIs ↗](https://docs.xbow.com/console/reference/asset-types) reachable from the public internet. In January 2026 it[named WonLae Lee, formerly of Samsung SDS, as General Manager for South Korea ↗](https://xbow.com/news/xbow-appoints-wonlae-lee-as-general-manager-south-korea) . Its funding release names[Samsung as a preferred reseller in Korea ↗](https://xbow.com/news/xbow-secures-additional-35m-from-strategic-investors) , and[Samsung SDS uses XBOW ↗](https://xbow.com/news/samsung-sds-strengthens-cybersecurity-competitiveness) for attack simulation. It has no Korean data region, and our[MindFort vs XBOW](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-xbow) comparison goes deeper.


### 3. What is Pentera best for?


Pentera validates security controls across networks, Active Directory, and cloud. Its[AI web app pentesting ↗](https://pentera.io/press-release/pentera-ai-web-app-pentesting/) is still in beta for selected customers. Its[contact page ↗](https://pentera.io/company/contact-us/) lists no Korean office or partner. Its[AWS Marketplace listing ↗](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-56i5cowyjxcxm) is $120,000 for 12 months, and our[MindFort vs Pentera](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-pentera) comparison goes deeper.


### 4. What is Horizon3.ai NodeZero best for?


NodeZero runs autonomous pentests against networks, Active Directory, and cloud. Its[WebApp module launched in July 2026 ↗](https://horizon3.ai/news/press-release/nodezero-webapp-launch/) , so web testing is newer than its network core. We found no Korean partner.[AWS Marketplace pricing ↗](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-l4tou5vhpvarm) starts at $25,000 a year for 500 assets, and our[MindFort vs Horizon3.ai](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-horizon3) comparison goes deeper.


### 5. What is RunSybil best for?


RunSybil's agent[tests web and API attack surfaces ↗](https://www.runsybil.com/platform) in black-box, grey-box, or white-box mode. It[raised $40M led by Khosla Ventures ↗](https://www.runsybil.com/post/runsybil-raises-40m-to-build-the-ai-native-platform-for-offensive-security) in March 2026. Its[trust center ↗](https://trust.runsybil.com/) lists SOC 2 Type 2 and no hosting region. We found no partners or offices in Korea, and our[MindFort vs RunSybil](https://www.mindfort.ai/compare/mindfort-vs-runsybil) comparison goes deeper.


### 6. What is PentAGI best for?


[PentAGI ↗](https://github.com/vxcontrol/pentagi) is a free, MIT-licensed multi-agent system that you host yourself. It runs tools like nmap, Metasploit, and sqlmap inside an isolated Docker sandbox. It can use local models, which helps firms working under network separation or CSAP rules. You run and patch it yourself with community support only.


## How do AI tools compare with SK Shieldus and Theori?


Korea's leading security firms bring deep testing teams, and both now use AI. They fit one-off needs like a pre-certification review, a red team exercise, or a regulator-driven audit. They cost more per test and run on a fixed schedule.


### What does SK Shieldus offer?


SK Shieldus runs[EQST ↗](https://www.digitaltoday.co.kr/en/view/84966/) , a white-hat group of about 200 people that does penetration testing and red teaming. After the bank attacks, it[published guidance ↗](https://www.dailian.co.kr/news/view/1699227) warning that AI amplifies attacks on unmanaged exposed assets and APIs. Pricing is quoted per engagement.


### What does Theori offer?


Theori[placed third in DARPA's AI Cyber Challenge finals ↗](https://therecord.media/darpa-ai-code-competition-winner-def-con) and won $1.5 million. Its human team has won the DEF CON CTF nine times. Its[Xint products ↗](https://xint.io/) bring AI pentesting to code and live apps, which makes Theori a hybrid between a services firm and an AI platform.


## How should a Korean company choose an AI pentesting tool?


Start with what you need to test and how often. Then check each vendor against this list:


- **Scope:** web apps, APIs, internal networks, cloud, or source code
- **Proof:** a working exploit for every finding
- **Fixes:** patch pull requests and automatic retests
- **Evidence:** reports and an attestation letter for ISMS-P audits
- **Data residency:** where test data and LLM calls go
- **Cost:** a monthly price you can compare with a per-engagement quote

## FAQ


### Does ISMS-P require a penetration test?


It will. In April 2026, MSIT and the PIPC announced that ISMS-P audits will add vulnerability diagnosis and penetration testing. Full rollout comes in 2027.


### How were AI tools used in the 2026 Korean bank hacks?


CrowdStrike found the attacker used ARTEX, an agentic pentesting tool developed in China. It ran on models including DeepSeek and Claude Code. At least seven financial institutions and at least 68,000 customers were affected.


### How much do PIPA fines cost Korean companies?


The amended PIPA took effect on September 11, 2026. Fines can now reach 10% of total revenue for serious or repeated violations. SK Telecom was fined KRW 134.8 billion for its 2025 breach.


### Can Korean financial firms use cloud AI for security testing?


Some can. The FSC has granted network separation exemptions so selected financial firms can use external AI for tasks like vulnerability testing. It postponed the next round on October 6, 2026, after the bank hacks.
